verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents webhooks that report when crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent, and monitor jobs start, progress, or finish, with HMAC-signed delivery, plus a per-scrape audit event stream. These cover job-status notification and some monitoring. Data-quality validation is only implied by schema-based structured extraction, and there is no explicit failure-alerting or performance-metrics capability. missing for 10: job performance metrics/dashboard, explicit failure alerts (e.g. failed-job events or alert rules), data-quality validation beyond schema extraction, independent corroboration.
